comments: The two instances (ID:6013) and (ID:6014) listed in the [8H6M69W4] have the same folio size and the same script. They appear to feature chapters of the same work, a commentary on the Pramāṇaviniścaya, the third chapter of which (gzhan don le'u) is lost.
